objective: Add the remaining additive Cycle Nine IRIS Core goal and multi-agent orchestration capabilities: persistent measurable goals, dependency-ordered task graphs, bounded parallel workers with separate compacted context, pause/resume/cancel/steer controls, independent review, overlapping-write conflict detection, durable recovery state, and hash-chained evidence without removing or weakening any existing Phase 0 or Cycle Nine machinery.
issuer: Founder Cristofer Stoic Arellano through Codex
completion_mandate_text: Founder mandate: preserve all existing Phase 0 and cycle work and finish every remaining additive development cycle so IRIS can be handed off for Founder testing. The additive program was defined after the Phase 0 foundation program but does not claim that permanent Phase 0 graduation has passed. This task bundles bounded implementation, verification, repair, exact-path staging, commit, non-force branch push, pull-request creation, independent review, merge, synchronization, remote equality, and cleanup. It excludes secret use, spending, deployment, public or LAN exposure, administration, force-push, history rewrite, destructive operations, and final Phase 0 graduation execution.
completion_exclusions: Deletion, renaming, reclassification, or supersession of existing work
Deployment or public or LAN exposure
permitted_actions: Compose existing planning, worker, coordination, audit, and execution contracts without weakening them
Use injected hermetic worker, reviewer, clock, and durable-store adapters
Run independent worker tasks concurrently only when their declared write sets do not overlap
Complete the ordinary governed repository lifecycle
prohibited_actions: Allow a worker to self-approve or widen authority
Persist raw secrets or unbounded model context
Remove or weaken existing Phase 0 or Cycle Nine machinery
Deploy, spend, administer, force-push, rewrite history, or execute final graduation
required_evidence: Persistent goal and dependency graph recovery
Parallelism only for non-overlapping write sets
Separate compacted worker contexts and steering
Pause, resume, cancellation, reviewer separation, and failure recovery
Exact paths, checks, remote equality, rollback, and cleanup
publisher: Codex under Founder completion mandate after exact-patch verification
